name: astravia-ui-design
description: Build and edit design documents (.astravia-design) on the Astravia design canvas — app screens, landing pages, slides, posters, infographics. Use when the user asks for a UI design, mockup, screen, deck, or poster, or attaches a design frame/element from the canvas. Frames are real React (TSX) routes, not pictures. Do NOT use for ordinary front-end work in the user's own codebase — building, styling or reworking pages of a real app is that repo's job, and none of the astravia-design_* tools or canvas rules here apply to it.
